events.comment: PLAYER CONTROLS - Left / Right movement (arrows or A / D)
SPRINT - holding Shift raises the max speed (movement settings in the editor are unchanged)
PLAYER CONTROLS - Jump (Space, Up arrow or W). Holding the key keeps the jump going a bit higher.
ANIMATIONS - walk while moving, idle when standing still (both only while on the ground)
ANIMATIONS - air check first so ground animations never override Jumping
BATTERY - EnergyPickup collect: recharge +20, capped at 100, then remove the pickup
CAMERA - follow the Player horizontally, clamped to the level bounds (viewport width from SceneWindowWidth)
CAMERA - vertical: dead zone when grounded, full-sprite visibility clamp in air, smoothed
VICTORY - interact with the generator: E key inside the trigger zone with battery remaining
Background layer: mirror the gameplay camera so the world-space background stays aligned (no gameplay camera change).

tests.description: Player falls onto the floor, walks left/right with arrows and A/D, and jumps with Space reaching a clear height.
tests.name: Player platformer controls
source: // Gravity: the player should be resting on the floor (not falling forever)
harness.assert(Math.abs(ySettled - yStart) < 2, 'Player settled on the floor (gravity + ground collision), y=' + ySettled);
harness.assert(rightX > startX + 40, 'Right arrow moved the player right (' + startX.toFixed(0) + ' -> ' + rightX.toFixed(0) + ')');
harness.assert(leftX < rightX - 40, 'A key moved the player left (' + rightX.toFixed(0) + ' -> ' + leftX.toFixed(0) + ')');
for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { await harness.stepFrames(1); peakY = Math.min(peakY, harness.getObjects('Player')[0].y); }
harness.assert(peakY < beforeJumpY - 60, 'Space made the player jump up (y ' + beforeJumpY.toFixed(0) + ' -> peak ' + peakY.toFixed(0) + ')');
const landed = await harness.stepUntil(() => { const p = harness.getObjects('Player')[0]; return p && Math.abs(p.y - beforeJumpY) < 3; }, { maxFrames: 300 });
harness.assert(landed, 'Player fell back down and landed on the floor');
harness.assert(walking === 'Walk', 'Player plays the Walk animation while moving (got ' + walking + ')');
harness.assert(idle === 'Idle', 'Player plays the Idle animation when standing (got ' + idle + ')');

tests.description: Verifies Idle/Walk/Run/Jump animation states and that sprint (Shift) is faster than walk.
tests.name: Player animation states
source: harness.assert(anim() === 'Idle', 'Idle on floor, not moving (got ' + anim() + ')');
harness.assert(anim() === 'Walk', 'Walk while moving without Shift (got ' + anim() + ')');
harness.assert(anim() === 'Run', 'Run while moving with Shift (got ' + anim() + ')');
harness.assert(anim() === 'Idle', 'Back to Idle after landing (got ' + anim() + ')');
harness.assert(runSpeed > walkSpeed * 1.2, 'Sprint is faster: walk ' + walkSpeed.toFixed(0) + ' px/s vs run ' + runSpeed.toFixed(0) + ' px/s');

source: harness.assert(pickup.y > 280 && pickup.y < 340, 'EnergyPickup sits just above the platform (top y=' + pickup.y + ')');
// Arrange: drop the player just left of the pickup, above the platform, so it lands on it
harness.setObjectPosition(player.id, 560, 200); // just left of the pickup (pickup x=625)
return p.y >= 180 && p.y <= 330; // standing on platform top (326 - height 124 = ~202)

tests.description: Player can traverse all platforms of the extended Level01 and reach the final generator platform.
tests.name: Level traversal to generator platform
source: // Route (platform tops): floating(326) -> A(250) -> B(190) -> C(260) -> final(400)
let idx = 0, failed = null, lastX = -999, lastProgressFrame = 0, jumpHeld = 0;
for (let i = 0; i < 8000 && idx < route.length; i++) {
if (!p) { failed = 'player missing at frame ' + i; break; }
if (p.y > 700) { failed = 'fell out at x=' + p.x + ' targeting ' + route[idx].name; break; }
const onFloor = bh ? bh.state.IsOnFloor !== false : false;
// Waypoint reached: standing on this platform (bottom near its top) within x range
// Stuck detection: if barely moved for 150 frames, force a jump burst
if (Math.abs(p.x - lastX) > 10) { lastX = p.x; lastProgressFrame = i; }
else if (dx < -15) { harness.setKeyPressed('Left', true); harness.setKeyPressed('Right', false); }
harness.setKeyPressed('Right', false); harness.setKeyPressed('Left', false); harness.setKeyPressed('Space', false);
harness.assert(idx >= route.length, 'Player traversed all platforms (reached ' + idx + '/' + route.length + ')');
harness.assert(p && p.x > 1700, 'Player stands on the final platform (x=' + (p && p.x) + ', y=' + (p && p.y) + ')');

tests.description: Camera follows Player horizontally with clamped bounds; HUD stays on fixed UI layer.
tests.name: Camera follow and HUD
source: harness.assert(hud && !hud.hidden && hud.layer === 'UI', 'BatteryText visible on UI layer');
harness.assert(Math.abs(cam.x - 480) < 2, 'Camera clamped at left boundary (x=' + cam.x + ')');
// Move player to middle of level: camera should follow freely (no clamp in 480..1580)
harness.assert(followed, 'Camera follows player in the middle (cam.x=' + Math.round(cam.x) + ', center=' + Math.round(mid.centerX) + ')');
harness.assert(cam.y >= 130 && cam.y <= 400, 'Camera Y stays inside its clamped range (y=' + cam.y.toFixed(0) + ')');
// Move to the far right: camera clamps at 1580
harness.assert(Math.abs(cam.x - 1580) < 2, 'Camera clamped at right boundary 2060-480=1580 (x=' + Math.round(cam.x) + ')');

tests.description: Vertical dead-zone camera: no bounce on small jumps, follows on high/low platforms with bounds.
tests.name: Vertical camera dead zone
source: harness.assert(Math.abs(cam.y - startY) < 2, 'Small jump does not move camera Y (y=' + cam.y + ')');
// High platform B: camera moves UP, clamped at 310
harness.assert(cam.y >= 309 && cam.y <= 311, 'Clamped at upper bound 310 (y=' + cam.y + ')');
// Floor: camera back DOWN, clamped at 400
harness.assert(cam.y >= startY - 2 && cam.y <= 401, 'Back at lower bound 400 on the floor (y=' + cam.y + ')');
harness.assert(hud && !hud.hidden && hud.layer === 'UI', 'BatteryText still fixed on UI layer');

tests.description: Smoothed camera: direction changes, full jump arc from highest platform fully visible, descent, boundaries, HUD.
tests.name: Smoothed camera and jump arc visibility
source: // 1. Direction change test mid-level: teleport to x=600 first, walk right then left
harness.assert(camAfterLeft < camAfterRight, 'Camera moved back left after direction change (right=' + Math.round(camAfterRight) + ', left=' + Math.round(camAfterLeft) + ')');
if (prev !== null) maxJump = Math.max(maxJump, Math.abs(cx - prev));
harness.assert(maxJump < 12, 'No abrupt horizontal snapping (max per-frame move=' + maxJump.toFixed(1) + 'px)');
// 2. Full jump arc from the highest platform B: entire sprite stays visible
console.log('apex player y=' + Math.round(minY) + ', best sprite-top screen y=' + Math.round(minVisibleTop));
harness.assert(minY < 60, 'Player reached the full jump arc above platform B (min y=' + Math.round(minY) + ')');
harness.assert(minVisibleTop >= 0, 'ENTIRE sprite stayed on screen at apex (best sprite-top screen y=' + Math.round(minVisibleTop) + 'px)');
// 3. Landing on B, then descending to the floor: camera returns down, bounds respected
// 4. Far right end: horizontal boundary preserved
harness.assert(hud && !hud.hidden && hud.layer === 'UI', 'BatteryText still fixed on UI layer');
await harness.takeScreenshot('after jump arc from highest platform');

tests.description: Generator reachable, victory on touch with battery, Victory scene texts, GameOver path intact.
tests.name: Generator victory objective
source: // A) Player reaches the Generator with normal movement and victory triggers
console.log('Generator at x=' + Math.round(gen.x) + ' y=' + Math.round(gen.y) + ' bottom=' + Math.round(gen.y + gen.height));
// Drop the player on the final platform (starts x=1620), left of the generator (x=1750)
harness.assert(landed.behaviors.PlatformerObject.state.IsOnFloor === true, 'Player standing on final platform (bottom=' + Math.round(landed.y + landed.height) + ')');
let won = await harness.stepUntil(() => harness.getSceneName() === 'Victory', { maxFrames: 300 });
harness.assert(won, 'Touching Generator with Battery > 0 changed to Victory scene');
harness.assert(title && title.text === 'POWER RESTORED', 'Victory title text present');
harness.assert(sub && sub.text === 'You kept the last spark alive.', 'Victory subtitle text present');
// C) Battery depletion without touching Generator still leads to GameOver
let over = await harness.stepUntil(() => harness.getSceneName() === 'GameOver', { maxFrames: 600 });
harness.assert(over, 'Battery depletion without generator leads to GameOver');

tests.description: Generator interaction: no auto-victory, E-key only inside zone, prompt visibility, GameOver intact.
tests.name: Generator interaction trigger
source: // 1. Walking into/past the generator does NOT auto-trigger victory
harness.assert(harness.getSceneName() === 'Level01', 'No automatic victory on approach/collision (scene=' + harness.getSceneName() + ')');
// 2. Jumping near/above the generator does not trigger
harness.assert(harness.getSceneName() === 'Level01', 'No victory from jumping near the generator');
// 3. Walk back into the trigger zone (1700-1745) and check the prompt
harness.assert(harness.getSceneName() === 'Level01', 'Still no auto-victory inside the zone');
harness.assert(prompt && !prompt.hidden, 'Prompt visible while in the interaction zone');
// 4. Pressing E outside the zone does nothing
harness.setObjectPosition(p.id, 1625, 280); // on platform, left of trigger
harness.assert(harness.getSceneName() === 'Level01', 'Pressing E outside the zone does nothing');
// 5. Pressing E inside the zone with Battery > 0 triggers Victory
let won = await harness.stepUntil(() => harness.getSceneName() === 'Victory', { maxFrames: 120 });
harness.assert(won, 'E inside the zone with Battery > 0 triggers Victory');
// 6. Battery depletion still leads to GameOver
let over = await harness.stepUntil(() => harness.getSceneName() === 'GameOver', { maxFrames: 600 });
harness.assert(over, 'Battery depletion still leads to GameOver');

tests.description: Prompt hides when leaving the zone OR battery empty; E interaction still gated correctly.
tests.name: Generator prompt visibility
source: // 1. Walk into the zone: prompt appears
harness.assert(!harness.getObjects('GeneratorPrompt')[0].hidden, '1. Prompt appears inside the zone with Battery > 0');
// 2. Leave the zone entirely (main floor, far away): prompt disappears
harness.assert(harness.getObjects('GeneratorPrompt')[0].hidden, '2. Prompt disappears when the Player leaves the zone');
// 3. Return to the zone, then drain Battery to 0 while staying inside: prompt must hide
harness.assert(!harness.getObjects('GeneratorPrompt')[0].hidden, '3a. Prompt visible again inside the zone');
harness.assert(harness.getObjects('GeneratorPrompt')[0].hidden, '3b. Prompt hidden when Battery = 0 even inside the zone');
// 4. E inside the zone with Battery = 0 does NOT trigger victory
harness.assert(harness.getSceneName() === 'Level01', '4a. E with Battery = 0 does not trigger Victory');
// Restore battery, still inside the zone: prompt returns and E triggers Victory
harness.assert(!harness.getObjects('GeneratorPrompt')[0].hidden, '4b. Prompt returns when Battery > 0 inside the zone');
let won = await harness.stepUntil(() => harness.getSceneName() === 'Victory', { maxFrames: 120 });
harness.assert(won, '4c. E inside the zone with Battery > 0 triggers Victory');
await harness.takeScreenshot('victory after prompt logic fix');

harness.assert(bg0.x <= 0 && bg0.y <= -140, 'background extends past level/camera Y range (x=' + bg0.x + ', y=' + bg0.y + ')');

harness.assert(harness.getObjects('EnergyPickup').length === 3, 'three energy pickups placed at scene start');
// The background must not be pickable/collidable: it never moves or disappears while the player runs through it.

tag + ': background covers viewport X (cam.x=' + cam.x.toFixed(0) + ', bg ' + Math.round(bg.x) + '..' + Math.round(bg.x + bg.width) + ')');

tag + ': background covers viewport Y (cam.y=' + cam.y.toFixed(0) + ', bg ' + Math.round(bg.y) + '..' + Math.round(bg.y + bg.height) + ')');
harness.assert(bg.x === -185 && bg.y === -140, tag + ': background keeps its world position (no parallax/drift)');
tag + ': Background layer camera mirrors gameplay camera (bg cam ' + (cb && cb.x.toFixed(1)) + ',' + (cb && cb.y.toFixed(1)) + ' vs ' + cam.x.toFixed(1) + ',' + cam.y.toFixed(1) + ')');
harness.assert(onHighest, 'player landed on the highest platform');
harness.assert(Math.abs(camGen.x - 1580) < 3, 'camera still clamped at right boundary 1580 (got ' + camGen.x.toFixed(0) + ')');
harness.assert(harness.getObjects('EnergyPickup').length <= 3, 'energy pickups only removed by the player (never by the background)');
harness.assert(!!hud && hud.layer === 'UI' && hud.hidden === false, 'HUD still visible on the UI layer');
harness.assert(!!p && p.y < 500, 'player still standing on a platform (y=' + (p && p.y.toFixed(0)) + ')');
